decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the completion of work.
Condition : 5 - The extension hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as No. 42 Albion Road.

Condition : 6 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank (western and eastern) walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - Notwithstanding the details shown in the approved plans, the front elevation of the proposed two-storey side extension shall be finished in pebble dashing painted off white to match the front elevation of the main house, its side elevation finished in brickwork to match the side elevation of the main house, and its rear elevation as well as the rear elevation of the part single-storey rear extension rendered to match the rear elevation of the main house.  This shall be permanently retained.

Condition : 8 - No part of the roof of the single-storey rear extension shall be used as or altered to form a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 9 - The garage or car parking accommodation shown on drawing No. 02, Rev P4, received 02.09.04 shall be permanently available and not be used for any purpose other than the parking of vehicles.  Tthereafter it shall not be used for any purpose other than the parking of vehicles.
description: Erection of a  two storey side extension,  part single storey rear extension and roof extension to dwellinghouse.
